problem_type: Asset insertion loses the source coordinate convention
symptom: A newly added real valley is upside down relative to the source director console.
direct_cause: AssetsTab.addFileAsset assigns zero rotation to both ordinary models and Gaussian splat sources.
class_root: The shared creation boundary does not preserve the declared source orientation of each asset kind.
affected_population: New linked and uploaded splat entities
internal_only_reason: This is approved source-product parity, not a universal SPZ-format axis claim. In the reference director console ordinary models start at rotation 0 and splat assets at X180. Spark consumes authored transforms without deciding this creation default.
invariants: New splat assets start at X180, while ordinary models retain their upright source axes.
Stored or user-edited transforms are never renormalized when the entity loads or is renamed.
generality_proof: Every asset-list origin invokes the same addFileAsset callback. Selecting the default by asset kind there covers every origin without filename/provider exceptions or persistent-data rewriting.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Apply the approved source orientation once, when creating a new entity from an asset.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Double-click and add action both invoke addFileAsset with kind splat.
Uploaded root and nested splats retain kind and invoke the same addFileAsset callback.
Persisted and imported scene-object rotations are authored transforms; they must not receive a second source-axis correction.

recurrence.reason: Every new splat from any asset-list origin receives the wrong default again.
same_class_scan: Read AssetsTab renderLinked/renderItem/addFileAsset and all model/splat creation defaults.
Compared the reference splat/model creation branches and DirectorEntities transform application; inspected normalizeScene to exclude authored scene imports.

prevention.invariant: New asset entities derive their source orientation from asset kind at the single shared creation boundary.
prevention.failure_mode: Asset kinds retain their existing routing; orientation is assigned only on new splat creation, with no mutation of existing objects.
prevention.strategy: Replace the unconditional zero default with the source-product splat/model orientation rule in addFileAsset.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removes the unconditional zero rotation at asset insertion; no alternate insertion implementation is introduced.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The source-product creation default is controlled by Nomi asset insertion, not a loader or dependency version.

migration: No automatic migration: existing project object rotations may be authored. Only newly inserted assets use the corrected default.
residual_risks: The source-product splat default may need manual user rotation for scans authored with another coordinate convention; no format-wide claim is made.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/panels/side/AssetsTab.tsx 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
